tariffsList.name: KiData Free
tariffsList.description: With the Plus plan, you can manage any number of displays and benefit from precise content control via configurable categories, industry filters, and predefined multi-filters.With up to 15 user accounts, advanced analytics features, and the option to export to PDF and CSV, this plan is ideal for teams with professional requirements.You can use up to 20 playlists with spots up to 30 seconds long and up to 30 minutes long – ideal for structured and longer campaigns.50 design templates, 10 GB of cloud storage, a sophisticated duplication workflow, and private mode round out the package. Support is available via email.
benefits: 1 screen, 1 playlist, campaigns up to 24 hours

Manual synchronization only
